headline: Admin direct invitation feature
description:
Objective

Implement the admin direct invitation flow tracked in .copilot/tasks/2026-04-24-admin-direct-invitation/.

Scope

  • Activate /admin/invitations
  • Allow admins to send invitations directly by email with role selection
  • List pending, accepted, expired, and revoked invitations
  • Allow revocation of pending invitations
  • Preserve the existing invite acceptance flow

Acceptance Criteria

  • Only authenticated admins can access the page and API routes
  • Duplicate pending invitations return a clear error
  • The feature works independently of REGISTRATION_MODE
  • Validation results are recorded in the repo task workspace

Task Workspace

.copilot/tasks/2026-04-24-admin-direct-invitation/
